name: document-stats-popover
title: Document stats popover
description: Words, characters, sentences and reading time for a document or the current selection, with an optional goal, from the editor footer.
docs: Pass text, and selectionText while something is selected: the button reads 412 words (or 36 of 412 words) and the panel shows words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs and the time to read and to say it aloud, tagged Document or Selection. Words and sentences are counted by the rules of the locale. goal adds a bar and Goal: 800 words, 388 to go. A text over 20,000 characters is counted in idle time, so typing never waits for it, and a screen reader hears the new count only once typing has paused. wordsPerMinute and speakingWordsPerMinute set the pace. trigger replaces the button. The panel is never taller than the room there is; on a short screen it scrolls inside itself. countText, in the item's stats file, counts a text for DocumentStatsPanel when you use the panel alone.
